name: CorePad
tagline: A simple lightweight but powerful text editor
blurb: CorePad is a small but powerful text-editor with syntax-highlighting support for a dozen or more languages.
description: CorePad is a small but powerful text-editor with syntax-highlighting support for a dozen or more languages. With a powerful SH engine based on QSyntaxHighlighter, it renders heavy codes as large as 20k LoC and above, almost effortlessly. By default CorePad provides support for 15 common languages, namely, C, C++, CS, CSS, Desktop, Go, Html, Java, JS, MD, PHP, Python, sh and XML. And it is very easy to extend support for other languages.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
